q: Someone shows signs of a stroke (face drooping, arm weakness, speech difficulty). Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Give them a heavy meal
Note the time and call an ambulance immediately
Keep the person comfortable
Do not give food or drink
e: 'Give them a heavy meal' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You get a video call where a relative's face and voice urgently ask for money. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Report suspicious calls
Keep it secret from your family
Verify by calling the relative on their known number
Be alert to deepfakes
e: 'Keep it secret from your family' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: A gas cylinder's rubber tube catches fire. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Call the fire brigade (101/112)
Pour petrol to make it burn out
Turn off the regulator if it is safe
Cover the flame with a wet sack
e: 'Pour petrol to make it burn out' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You work with machines in a workshop. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Tie back long hair and avoid loose clothes
Switch off machines before cleaning
Operate machines without training
Wear proper protective equipment (PPE)
e: 'Operate machines without training' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: An adult collapses, is unresponsive and not breathing normally. What is the right thing to do?
o: Shake them violently and leave
Give them water
Wait for them to wake up
Push hard and fast at 100–120 compressions per minute
e: Correct: Push hard and fast at 100–120 compressions per minute. The other choices are unsafe.

q: A person has severe chest pain spreading to the left arm and is sweating. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Call an ambulance immediately
Make them sit and rest
Give them a cold drink and leave them alone
Loosen tight clothing
e: 'Give them a cold drink and leave them alone' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: Your computer shows a message demanding money to unlock your files (ransomware). Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Restore from a backup
Disconnect from the internet
Report it to the cyber cell (1930)
Click more links in the message
e: 'Click more links in the message' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: A person has severe chest pain spreading to the left arm and is sweating. What is the right thing to do?
o: Give them a cold drink and leave them alone
Ignore it as gas
Ask them to walk to the hospital
Loosen tight clothing
e: Correct: Loosen tight clothing. The other choices are unsafe.

q: Someone sends you a UPI 'collect request' saying you will receive money. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Report the number
Decline the request
Share your screen with them
Remember you never need a PIN to receive money
e: 'Share your screen with them' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: A person is bleeding heavily from a cut on the arm. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Raise the arm above heart level if possible
Press firmly on the wound with a clean cloth
Wash it with hot water for long
Get medical help quickly
e: 'Wash it with hot water for long' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You are 16 years old and want to drive a car. What is the right thing to do?
o: Race with friends
Wait until you are 18 and get a driving licence
Drive after taking medicines that cause drowsiness
Drive the family car on the highway
e: Correct: Wait until you are 18 and get a driving licence. The other choices are unsafe.

q: Someone sends you a UPI 'collect request' saying you will receive money. What is the right thing to do?
o: Enter your UPI PIN to receive money
Share your screen with them
Report the number
Approve requests from strangers
e: Correct: Report the number. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You are using free public Wi-Fi at a café. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Avoid online banking on it
Accept unknown file transfers
Use websites with HTTPS
Turn off file sharing
e: 'Accept unknown file transfers' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.
